## What

`extract` ran its stages one after another. Two of them need nothing from the structural pass's later work, so they now run beside it (perf report F9 and F11).

- F11: the checker thread starts and its program is opened (createSnapshot) as soon as the project is parsed and merged, before dependency loading and resolution. The root-file list is predicted from the merged mappings by `predicted_root_files` (same key rule and order as `assemble`). When the request exists, `EarlyStart::fits` compares the predicted list, project root, tsconfig and timeout with the request's own; equal means the opened program is used, anything else means it is stopped and the run opens its own as before. A failed early open yields the same outcome message as the serial path.

## What

`extract` ran its stages one after another. Two of them need nothing from the structural pass's later work, so they now run beside it (perf report F9 and F11).

- F11: the checker thread starts and its program is opened (createSnapshot) as soon as the project is parsed and merged, before dependency loading and resolution. The root-file list is predicted from the merged mappings by `predicted_root_files` (same key rule and order as `assemble`). When the request exists, `EarlyStart::fits` compares the predicted list, project root, tsconfig and timeout with the request's own; equal means the opened program is used, anything else means it is stopped and the run opens its own as before. A failed early open yields the same outcome message as the serial path.
- F9: on a rerun the kept answer is read and its recorded questions are asked on a thread (`validate_kept_early`) while the structural pass runs; the request key is compared afterwards (`Validated::outcome`). `kept::load` is now `read` -> `Read::validate` -> `Validated::outcome`.
- Policy: with a kept file present only F9 runs (a program opened for a likely hit would take the structural pass's cores); with none, or `--no-cache`, only F11 runs.
- Guards untouched: `session`/`answer_opened` (#440 lane panic, refusal spoils the notes, release) is the old code, only split out of `answer_with`; the kept answer is still saved before the call returns, and `Teardown::OneShot` still forgets the runtime and converters (#448).

Files beyond the brief's two: `crates/semantic/src/lib.rs`, `crates/core/src/pipeline/{mod,revision}.rs` (the hook after `Indexed::build`, and the public early API). Needed; the brief's files cannot reach either.

## Evidence

- Output identity (`same.py`, JSON parsed, stats dropped) vs origin/main release build, on gate-large and chakra-only, default and `--load-dependencies --collapse-inherited-props none`, cold (`--no-cache`) and from the kept answer: all 12 comparisons IDENTICAL.
- Early start is used on both fixtures (`-vv`: "semantic program built program_ms" 82 -> 0 on gate-large, 68 -> 0 on chakra-only; the program is ready before the structural pass ends).
- Load-independent counts, 3 runs each, base vs new, cold: instructions retired gate-large 57.0-57.5 G vs 57.3-57.4 G, chakra-only 42.9-43.2 G vs 42.9-43.0 G; max RSS gate-large 995-1002 MB vs 993-1005 MB, chakra-only 729-741 MB vs 713-723 MB. No extra work, no extra memory.
- Tests: `the_root_files_handed_out_early_are_those_the_finished_output_gives` (duplicate component names, a file exporting nothing); `a_file_edited_between_reading_the_answer_and_validating_it_discards_it` (written first; fails when `validate` trusts a result computed at read time: observed `assertion failed: read.validate().is_none()`); `a_validated_answer_is_given_only_for_the_request_it_was_made_for`; `an_early_start_gives_the_answer_a_run_gives_and_a_wrong_one_is_dropped`.
- Exit codes 0: `just lint doc-check machete typos`; `cargo nextest run -p caliper-docgen-core -p caliper-docgen-semantic -p caliper-docgen` (1459 passed); `just test-checker-lane`; gate_harness `determinism` (all 9 variants equalsFirst) and `memory` (ok, finalEqualsFresh).

## Not verified

- Wall time: no A/B. `uptime` load1 was 8-14 throughout (limit 4). The saving is the 68-82 ms program build moving off the critical path for cold runs; rerun gain from F9 (kept validation 40-43 ms) was not measured.
- Residual window: with the validation now early, a source file edited during the first ~60 ms of a run (after validation, before the structural pass reads it) can pair new structure with the old kept answer. Before, such an edit was caught if it landed before validation. Same class of race as an edit after the load today, a wider window.
- A rerun after an edit has no F11 (the kept file exists, so no early program); it pays the serial program build as today.
- gate_harness `first-answer` and `watch`, oracle runs, and the other CI lanes not run.
